mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the new surface was satisfying: it closed the visible gap while showing that the tissue underneath still needed work.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the surface and then fitting it felt a little repetitive, even though the separate fitting made the completed layer clear.

surprise.text: The new capillary branch joined another vessel, creating a route for blood to reach nearby cells.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though clearing debris before fitting the prepared parts seemed like a required game sequence rather than a choice I understood in advance.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing the separate surface, support and blood-supply projects come together made healing understandable and satisfying.
